status: draft: frozen only after the user review (develop_logs/notes/20261108_batch_design_decisions.md section 13 step 5); generation of the large batch does not start before the freeze
scope: every generated motion of the large batch and of the official-evaluation batch, one run directory per motion; the generation system itself is not changed by this file (it belongs to another session); python/scripts/motion_contract_check.py validates run directories against it

L1_identity.purpose: who produced the motion and under which switch

required.intervention.json: the switch condition of the run

L1_identity.legacy: PRIMAL: one run directory holds every switch combination; the switch is the factorial file name (ground<g>_reproject<r>_inertialize<i>)

L2_task.purpose: one task format for every method; legacy runs use three formats (joint-position scenario, root goal change of CLoSD / DART, unconditioned continuation of PRIMAL) plus the Kimodo case files
L2_task.legacy: runs before the freeze lack required_new_batch and may use a legacy format; the check records the format, the evaluation maps them from the batch manifest and records the mapping

kinds.root_goal_change: constraints: root goals as {time_seconds, joint: pelvis, position_m (z null)} (legacy goal_start / goal_next / update_seconds)
kinds.continuation: constraints: []; initial_state {history, family, seed} (legacy PRIMAL initial_history / family / initial_seed)
kinds.object_interaction: constraints: object waypoints; object block in L5 (CHOIS)

L3_motion.purpose: the unified motion every evaluator reads

motion.npz.joints: (T, J, 3) float, finite, metres, right-handed Z-up world
motion.npz.metadata_json: units m, axes right-handed Z-up, native_axes, skeleton, native_joint_names

legacy_adapters.kimodo: case directory motion.npz with posed_joints (native Y-up SOMA77, 30 fps; biomech_sources.load)

L4_native.purpose: the full native representation, so that later evaluators (neck, shoulder, native-rotation distribution) can be added without re-generation
L4_native.file: native.npz (new batch); legacy locations are listed per method in method_capability.native_legacy

L5_world.purpose: the method's own conventions and physical quantities

required.floor_height_m: the floor the method declares, canonical Z (paper / code basis in floor_basis)
required.floor_basis: citation of the paper or code line

L5_world.legacy: the method floors of the legacy runs come from config/evalkit_floor_reference_20261107.json

required.failure: status != success keeps the run directory with failure.json; a failed item is never replaced by another seed

L6_integrity.legacy: manifest.json status and the analysis-level motion_sha256 stand in for integrity.json

method_capability._values: native: in the method output; derived: computed from other outputs (not independent information); absent; to_verify: claimed, not yet checked

closd.global_rotations_with_twist: absent (body orientations of the simulation not saved)

dart.joints: native (network joints; differ from the rotation forward kinematics by 7 mm mean)
dart.global_rotations_with_twist: native in the new export (smplx_params.npz, utils/motiogen/dart_native.py); absent in the legacy runs
dart.shoulder_girdle: to_verify (SMPL-X collar rotations in the new export; no scapula)

motionlcm.global_rotations_with_twist: absent (verified 2026-11-08: HumanML3D skeleton.inverse_kinematics_np builds the 263-d rotation part with qbetween from bone directions (shortest arc), so twist about each bone is zero by construction)
motionlcm.head_orientation: absent (head is a leaf joint: only the neck-head bone direction, no axial head rotation)
motionlcm.shoulder_girdle: absent (collar joint positions only: no scapula, no upper-arm twist)

omnicontrol.global_rotations_with_twist: absent (verified 2026-11-08: HumanML3D skeleton.inverse_kinematics_np builds the 263-d rotation part with qbetween from bone directions (shortest arc), so twist about each bone is zero by construction)
omnicontrol.head_orientation: absent (head is a leaf joint: only the neck-head bone direction, no axial head rotation)
omnicontrol.shoulder_girdle: absent (collar joint positions only: no scapula, no upper-arm twist)

primal.global_rotations_with_twist: native (verified 2026-11-08: pose 69 = transl 3 + global_orient axis-angle 3 + body_pose axis-angle 21x3 (PRIMAL motion_diffuser.aa2rotcont, motionclip._fwd_smplx_seq); generated in rotation space)
primal.head_orientation: native (SMPL-X head joint rotation in body_pose)

native_legacy.smplx_params: factorial/<switch>.npz pose (transl, global_orient, body_pose) + factorial/initial_history.npz betas

evaluator_requirements._values: needs: capability keys that must be native; conditional: {capability: what else is needed when the method has it}; L2 / L5 items are contract layers every new-batch run must carry

source_diagnostics.note: bone length, foot height against the method floor, penetration / hover depth, sliding; on the raw output

evalkit_residual_kinematic.note: heel / toe or ankle / foot named; mass 75 kg unless the task declares one (recorded)

evalkit_ergo.note: neck / shoulder source posture from named joints; skeletons without them score the source inputs as unknown (recorded)

conditional.objects: object_mass_kg (absent: lumbar reported with the held load not modelled)

neck.status: reserved (user 2026-11-08 15:16: other muscles kept as reserve); data stored now, evaluator added later; neck muscle model (HYOID) not integrated

shoulder.status: reserved; shoulder muscle model not downloaded

measurability_rule: an evaluator is measurable for a method if every needed capability is native (or derived where the requirement allows); to_verify counts as not measurable until verified; the matrix is written by motion_contract_check.py matrix and frozen with this file
